_about: What each company is owed at each stage, the list the CRM's company file triages against (Jonathan, 2026-10-04: a meeting booked on a call, the Loom brief not sent yet). One list per deal stage, in order. id: stable, never reused. text: the step as he reads it. why: one line under it. doc: the file that carries it (opens from the step). auto: what the CRM can see for itself, so he does not tick it (has_person, has_next_action, has_meeting). mail_body: words that, found in a message he sent to the company, mark the step done (the Loom link). mail_sent: true marks it done once any email to the company is in Sent. when: the step shows only after another step of the stage got that answer (the three no-show steps show once "show" is answered No-show; Jonathan, 2026-10-05: "we need a protocol for the no show"). Drawn from references/pipeline-process.md; edit here and the page follows on the next load. Ticks are kept in triage.json.

Contacted.text: Log who you spoke with: name and role
Contacted.why: The next call opens with their name.

Contacted.text: Send what you promised on the call
Contacted.why: The email they asked for, in your copy.

Contacted.text: Set the next action and its date
Contacted.why: A contacted company with no date goes quiet.

Booked.text: Meeting on the Monarc Build calendar with the Meet link, in their time zone
Log who booked it: name, role, email
Booked.why: The invite and the Loom go to a person, not an info@ box.

Booked.text: Send the confirmation the same day
Booked.why: The yes in writing, while it is warm.

Booked.text: Send the Loom brief: what we will set up so their lead flow runs smooth
Booked.why: Record it from the script, link it in an email before the meeting. A sent email to them with a loom.com link ticks this by itself.

Booked.text: Send the reminder the day before
Log show or no-show after the meeting
Booked.why: Move the deal to Held, or rebook. The answer feeds the show rate by Loom variation on Reports.

Booked.text: No-show: send the rebook email the same day
Booked.why: On the confirmation's thread: we missed each other, two new times in their zone, the same link. The SDR drafts it (.claude/skills/sdr/workflows/no-show.md).

Booked.text: No-show: send the LinkedIn message the same day
Booked.why: One line that points at the email, to the person who booked.

Booked.text: No-show: log the new time, or the close reason after three business days of silence
Booked.why: A no-show with no answer is closed with a reason, not left open.

Held.text: Log the close or the objection that stopped it
Held.why: One line on the deal; it feeds the Friday tally.

Held.text: Send the terms email with the signing link
Held.why: Pilot terms on one screen, the DocuSeal link.

Held.text: Set the follow-up and its date
Held.why: Terms with no follow-up date sit.

Proposed.text: Follow up by the next action date
Proposed.why: Two times and a length, in your copy.
Then the deal moves to Won.

Won.text: Kickoff booked and the questionnaire sent (/kickoff prep)
Won.why: The 45 minute call, five business days out.
